title: monotile-ca: cellular automata on the hat and spectre aperiodic monotilings
description:
The toolchain, search drivers, and complete replayable result set behind the papers Gliders on Aperiodic Monotilings: Cellular Automata on the Hat and Spectre and Certificates of Immortality for Gliders on the Hat and Spectre Tilings (James Edmond, 2026) and their companion interactive essay. Patch generation on the hat, spectre and Penrose tilings from finite-state transducers (Tatham), a no_std graph cellular-automaton engine compiled natively and to WebAssembly, exhaustive and evolutionary rule-space search with structural anti-gaming controls, cross-radius verification, and the constant-memory sliding-window tracker that flew the discovered gliders to a million rings; and, from version 1.1.0, the certify crate (legal-ball atlases by transducer exploration, situation closures, exact cocycles bounding heading and speed), the ten certificates of immortality and an independent checker. Every result record replays exactly from a small tuple.

Code is dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0 (the archive lists MIT; either applies).
notes: Companion papers: arXiv:2609.22579 (nlin.CG), "Gliders on Aperiodic Monotilings: Cellular Automata on the Hat and Spectre"; and "Certificates of Immortality for Gliders on the Hat and Spectre Tilings" (2026, arXiv identifier to be added on posting).
